summary: The requirements were re-grilled after decision 0163 changed Claude from durable provider-session resume to process-local continuity. Eleven conflicts with the older universal-resume contract were resolved in the amended spec; the closing round confirmed that no requirement gap remains.
gaps: The spec did not state which authority wins where the older universal-resume contract conflicts with the confirmed Claude amendment.
Marking, ceiling, and retirement language still applied universally even though Claude provider sessions are now process-local.
Retired provider-session references were inconsistent about whether agentSessionId is carried.
The rollout cleanup could be read as deleting durable DeepAgents rows as well as stale Claude rows.
Claude compaction, failover, stale-row filtering, and status behavior were not defined for process-local continuity.
The pinned test surface still treated cross-process Claude resume as expected behavior.
The acceptance criteria omitted the full process-local Claude lifecycle and cleanup surface.
The architecture requirement R7 still canonized universal durable provider resume.
The OpenAI-compatible cache capability booleans were left ambiguous even though both reads and writes are supported.
The high-water SQL contract did not explicitly include the lower-mark predicate needed for monotonic updates.
The observability contract did not prove that Claude has no resumable association while DeepAgents remains durable.
resolutions: The amended process-local Claude spec and accepted decision 0163 now take precedence for Claude-specific behavior.
Marking, ceiling, and retirement are explicitly limited to adapters declaring durable_resume continuity.
Every retired reference now consistently carries agentSessionId from the same committed read.
Rollout cleanup is Claude-only, clears both latest and run pointers, and explicitly preserves DeepAgents rows and checkpoints.
The spec now defines capability-driven Claude compaction, attempt-local failover, stale-row filtering, and status projections.
Obsolete Claude cross-process resume tests are replaced with process-local continuation and fresh-restart coverage.
Acceptance criteria now cover adapter capability, both Claude lanes, fresh restart context, compaction, failover, projections, filesystem cleanup, and drained rollout cleanup.
R7 and the architecture documentation are capability-aware: process_local for Claude and durable_resume for DeepAgents.
OpenAI-compatible cache read and write support are both recorded as true.
The high-water update now requires the lower-mark predicate as well as the session identity fence.
Observability must show no resumable Claude association and preserved durable DeepAgents continuity.

rounds.question: The requirements review found eleven conflicts between the old universal-resume cache-bug spec and the confirmed process-local Claude amendment. The artifact has now been amended so: (1) the amendment and decision 0163 take precedence for Claude; (2) mark/ceiling/retirement apply only to durable_resume adapters; (3) retired references carry agentSessionId; (4) rollout deletes only Claude rows and both latest/run pointers while preserving DeepAgents; (5) Claude compaction, failover, stale-row filtering, and status behavior are capability-driven; (6) obsolete Claude resume tests are replaced; (7) the full new acceptance surface is explicit; (8) architecture docs become capability-aware; (9) OpenAI-compatible cache booleans are true/true; (10) the high-water SQL includes the lower-mark predicate; and (11) observability proves Claude has no resumable association while DeepAgents remains. Confirm these resolutions and close the requirements frontier?
options: Confirm all eleven resolutions — frontier empty
rounds.chosen: Confirm all eleven resolutions — frontier empty
